Violation Category: Failure of reasonable security safeguards resulting in a breach
Penalty Exposure: Up to ₹250 crore — the Act's highest published cap
What It Typically Covers: Inadequate technical/organisational security that leads to an actual personal data breach

Violation Category: Failure to notify the Board or affected Data Principals of a breach
Penalty Exposure: A dedicated, substantial cap distinct from the underlying security failure
What It Typically Covers: Mishandling or missing the breach notification obligation itself

Violation Category: Children's data and verifiable parental consent violations
Penalty Exposure: A dedicated cap reflecting heightened statutory concern
What It Typically Covers: Processing children's data without proper verifiable parental consent or in breach of restrictions

Penalty Exposure: A dedicated cap for SDF-specific non-compliance
What It Typically Covers: DPO appointment, DPIA, independent audit and algorithmic accountability failures

Penalty Exposure: A lower residual cap for other violations
What It Typically Covers: Notice, consent-mechanics and general obligation failures not otherwise categorised

Penalty Exposure: A modest cap distinct from Data Fiduciary penalties
